# P + E on a trusted trigger — the ruling

A deploy job holds a credential and runs a shell. That is the definition of
shipping software, and it holds exactly two of three capabilities, which the
Agents Rule of Two calls **compliant**.

Both the fixture brief and the detector brief were told to escalate this case to
the main thread — a deadlock, since each could assume the other resolved it.

Ruling: silent at default verbosity. Warning on it means warning every repo that
ships software, for shipping software, and the cheapest fix would be "nothing".
It surfaces as `tridelphi/privileged-trusted-context` at note level, off by
default and never counted toward the exit code.
